description:
Input rasters, required fuel-model and ignition tables, GOFER arrival-time TIFFs and PNG previews, CAL FIRE final-perimeter GeoPackages and aligned 30 m burned-mask TIFFs for monument_2021. Input preparation and CAL FIRE perimeter-generation source code are included. The original scripts are preserved with case-local entry points. External GOFER and CAL FIRE source data and CloudFire access are required; regeneration from external sources has not been verified against frozen hashes. The generator for the supplied GOFER arrival-time TIFF and PNG was not provided. Source identification and file hashes record the updated ELMFIRE_GOFER_validation directory. Historical simulation outputs, runners and model configurations are excluded.

GOFER source attribution: Liu, Tianjia; Randerson, James T.; Chen, Yang; Morton, Douglas C.; Wiggins, Elizabeth B.; Smyth, Padhraic; Foufoula-Georgiou, Efi; Nadler, Roy; Nevo, Omer. GOES-Observed Fire Event Representation (GOFER) product for 28 California wildfires from 2019-2021. Zenodo, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8327264 (all versions). The supplied observations are derived arrival-time rasters; the exact source version and complete transformation history remain unverified. GOFER source license: CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. License evidence was checked against version 0.2 (2025), https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14642378; this does not establish which version was used for the supplied rasters.
